name: ai-sdlc-kit
description: AI SDLC toolkit for Claude Code: spec-driven workflow skills, sub-agents and mods

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Spec-driven AI SDLC workflow: from explore and grill-me to spec, tickets, parallel implementation, review and PR

plugins.name: sdlc-cache

plugins.name: sdlc-agents
plugins.description: Mod: a pane with the live tree of the session's subagents (/agent-tree)

plugins.name: sdlc-git
plugins.description: Mod: a pane with the repository's worktrees and branches (/git-panel)
